en: Colorized historic postcard view of a park with a pond in the foreground and tree-lined lawns leading to several multi‑story buildings and a towered structure in the background. The sky is lightly clouded, and the scene is tranquil and pastoral. Red printed text at the top identifies the location as Bischofswerda in Saxony and specifies the view as being at König-Friedrich-August Park.
